notes: Sourced from Williams AV's official specification sheet (MCAT 261D, "SPECIFICATION DATA WaveCAST WF T5," (c) 2022 Williams AV, LLC), hosted on the AV-iQ document CDN (cdn-docs.av-iq.com/Brochure/CAT261D-Wavecast.pdf). This sheet covers both serial-number variants of the WF T5 (A/B and C-or-later); the physical I/O is identical across both — only firmware/feature notes differ. The WF T5 is a single-channel Wi-Fi audio transmitter (WaveCAST platform) for assistive-listening/audio-over-Wi-Fi applications. Category "audio" and type "Other" are approximate — it doesn't cleanly fit the given type enum (closest real-world description is a "Wi-Fi audio transmitter/DSP processor"); left type unset since no listed type fits well. It is fundamentally a desktop unit (1/2 rack-space wide) that can optionally share a 1U rack space two-up with an accessory rack kit (RPK 005/006), so rackUnits is omitted per instructions for desktop units. The power supply is an external desktop transformer (Williams AV TFP 062): AC mains (100-240VAC 50/60Hz, IEC line cord) on the supply's input side, feeding 24VDC/750mA/18W to the WF T5 via a 2.5mm ID center-positive barrel connector — the barrel connector is what's modeled as the unit's own power port. Ethernet is 10/100 Base-T (IEEE 802.3), graded eth-100m since 10/100 tops out at Fast Ethernet (100 Mbps). The XLR/TRS combo input carries both mic and line signals plus phantom power on the same physical jack. Note: Williams AV's current catalog has moved on to the WF T5C ("WaveCAST C") successor with an OLED display and optional Dante; this device record is for the original WF T5 as specified in the sourced datasheet.

ports.name: Audio In
ports.note: Combination 3-pin XLR / 1/4" TRS jack; mic or line level, balanced or unbalanced, selectable phantom power (14.4VDC)

ports.name: Headphone
ports.note: 1/4" TRS stereo jack, mono signal, 15.7 mW max into 33 ohms; tied to rear input for monitoring

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: RJ-45, 10/100 Base-T, IEEE 802.3 compliant, supports CAT5e up to 328 ft (100m)

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: 2.5mm ID center-positive barrel connector; 24VDC, 750mA from external desktop transformer (TFP 062, AC input 100-240VAC 50/60Hz)
